body.sql: SELECT * FROM elb_logs WHERE elb_status_code = 504 LIMIT 10000;

SELECT count() AS error_count, toStartOfInterval(`@timestamp`, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS "span(`@timestamp`,5m)", elb_status_code FROM elb_logs WHERE elb_status_code >= 500 GROUP BY elb_status_code, "span(`@timestamp`,5m)" LIMIT 10000;

SELECT count() AS requestCount, toStartOfInterval(`@timestamp`, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time_bin, elb_status_code FROM elb_logs WHERE elb_status_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY elb_status_code, time_bin ORDER BY time_bin DESC LIMIT 10000;
SELECT count() AS requests, countIf(elb_status_code >= 400) AS errors, toStartOfHour(`@timestamp`) AS hour FROM elb_logs GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour LIMIT 10000;
SELECT count() AS total_requests, countIf(elb_status_code > 499) AS errors, round(errors * 100.0 / total_requests, 4) AS error_rate_pct FROM elb_logs;
SELECT count() AS requestCount, url_path FROM elb_logs WHERE elb_status_code >= 500 AND url_path IS NOT NULL GROUP BY url_path ORDER BY requestCount DESC LIMIT 10000;
SELECT * FROM elb_logs WHERE elb_status_code >= 500 ORDER BY `@timestamp` DESC, trace_id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1000;

SELECT count() AS c, elb_status_code, target_status_code FROM elb_logs WHERE elb_status_code IS NOT NULL AND target_status_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY elb_status_code, target_status_code ORDER BY c DESC, elb_status_code, target_status_code LIMIT 10000;
SELECT count() AS `count`, client_ip FROM elb_logs WHERE client_ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY `count` DESC LIMIT 10000;
SELECT count() AS c, http_method, client_ip FROM elb_logs WHERE http_method IS NOT NULL AND client_ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY http_method, client_ip ORDER BY c DESC, http_method, client_ip LIMIT 100;

SELECT count() AS `count`, client_ip, elb, request_url FROM elb_logs WHERE client_ip IS NOT NULL AND elb IS NOT NULL AND request_url IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_ip, elb, request_url ORDER BY `count` DESC LIMIT 10000;
SELECT request_url FROM elb_logs WHERE user_agent LIKE '%Safari%' ORDER BY `@timestamp`, trace_id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 10;

SELECT count() AS scanAttempts, min(`@timestamp`) AS first_seen, max(`@timestamp`) AS last_seen, client_ip, user_agent FROM elb_logs WHERE (request LIKE '%.env%' OR request LIKE '%admin%' OR request LIKE '%login%' OR request LIKE '%cgi-bin%' OR request LIKE '%remote/login%' OR request LIKE '%+CSCOE+%') AND client_ip IS NOT NULL AND user_agent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_ip, user_agent ORDER BY scanAttempts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT count() AS requests, quantileTDigest(0.99)(target_processing_time) AS latency_p99, countIf(elb_status_code >= 500) AS errors, user_agent, http_method, url_path FROM elb_logs WHERE target_processing_time > 0 AND user_agent IS NOT NULL AND http_method IS NOT NULL AND url_path IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_agent, http_method, url_path HAVING requests >= 10 ORDER BY latency_p99 DESC LIMIT 25;

SELECT count() AS requests, avg(target_processing_time) AS avg_latency, quantileTDigest(0.99)(target_processing_time) AS p99_latency, target_ip FROM elb_logs WHERE target_processing_time > 0 AND target_ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY target_ip ORDER BY avg_latency DESC LIMIT 10000;

SELECT avg_latency, q[1] AS p50, q[2] AS p90, q[3] AS p99, time_bin FROM (SELECT avg(target_processing_time) AS avg_latency, quantilesTDigest(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(target_processing_time) AS q, toStartOfInterval(`@timestamp`, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time_bin FROM elb_logs WHERE target_processing_time != -1 GROUP BY time_bin) ORDER BY time_bin DESC LIMIT 10000;

SELECT quantileTDigest(0.95)(target_processing_time) AS p95, count() AS c, elb_status_code FROM elb_logs WHERE target_processing_time >= 0 AND elb_status_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY elb_status_code ORDER BY elb_status_code LIMIT 10000;

SELECT avg(request_processing_time) AS average_request_processing_time, avg(target_processing_time) AS average_target_processing_time, avg(response_processing_time) AS average_response_processing_time FROM elb_logs;

SELECT `@timestamp`, request_url, target_processing_time, elb_status_code, target_status_code FROM elb_logs WHERE target_processing_time > 5 ORDER BY target_processing_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1000;

SELECT toStartOfHour(`@timestamp`) AS `@timestamp`, multiIf(elb_status_code IS NULL, 'NULL', elb_status_code IN (SELECT elb_status_code FROM elb_logs WHERE elb_status_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY elb_status_code ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 10), toString(elb_status_code), 'OTHER') AS elb_status_code, count() AS `count()` FROM elb_logs GROUP BY `@timestamp`, elb_status_code ORDER BY `@timestamp`, elb_status_code LIMIT 10000;
SELECT count(DISTINCT client_ip) AS unique_clients FROM elb_logs;

SELECT sum(received_bytes / 1000000.0) AS client_datareceived_megabytes, client_ip FROM elb_logs WHERE client_ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY client_datareceived_megabytes DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10000;

SELECT count() AS requestCount, min(`@timestamp`) AS firstLogTime, max(`@timestamp`) AS lastLogTime, avg(received_bytes + sent_bytes) AS avgTransactionSize, sum(received_bytes) AS totalBytesReceived, sum(sent_bytes) AS totalBytesSent, sum(received_bytes + sent_bytes) AS totalBytes, elb FROM elb_logs WHERE elb IS NOT NULL GROUP BY elb ORDER BY requestCount DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM elb_logs WHERE `@timestamp` >= '2026-09-23 00:00:00' AND `@timestamp` < '2026-09-24 00:00:00' ORDER BY `@timestamp`, trace_id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5000;
SELECT * FROM elb_logs ORDER BY `@timestamp` LIMIT 100;
SELECT count() AS c FROM elb_logs;
SELECT count() AS c, client_ip, url_path FROM elb_logs WHERE client_ip IS NOT NULL AND url_path IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_ip, url_path ORDER BY c DESC, client_ip, url_path LIMIT 10;

SELECT count() AS c, countIf(elb_status_code >= 400) AS sr, avg(received_bytes) AS arb, trace_id, client_ip FROM elb_logs WHERE trace_id IS NOT NULL AND client_ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trace_id, client_ip ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT count() AS c, conn_trace_id, toMinute(`@timestamp`) AS m, url_path FROM elb_logs WHERE url_path IS NOT NULL AND conn_trace_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY conn_trace_id, m, url_path ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT count() AS c, conn_trace_id, url_path FROM elb_logs WHERE url_path IS NOT NULL AND conn_trace_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY conn_trace_id, url_path LIMIT 10;

SELECT count() AS n, type, elb, target_port, elb_status_code, target_status_code, http_method, http_version, ssl_cipher, ssl_protocol, target_group_arn FROM elb_logs WHERE type IS NOT NULL AND elb IS NOT NULL AND target_port IS NOT NULL AND elb_status_code IS NOT NULL AND target_status_code IS NOT NULL AND http_method IS NOT NULL AND http_version IS NOT NULL AND ssl_cipher IS NOT NULL AND ssl_protocol IS NOT NULL AND target_group_arn IS NOT NULL GROUP BY type, elb, target_port, elb_status_code, target_status_code, http_method, http_version, ssl_cipher, ssl_protocol, target_group_arn ORDER BY n DESC, type, elb, target_port, elb_status_code, target_status_code, http_method, http_version, ssl_cipher, ssl_protocol, target_group_arn LIMIT 10;

SELECT count() AS n, type, elb, target_port, elb_status_code, target_status_code, http_method, http_version, ssl_cipher, ssl_protocol, target_group_arn, chosen_cert_arn, matched_rule_priority, actions_executed, target_status_code_list, classification, classification_reason, lb_node_ip, domain_name, url_host, target_ip FROM elb_logs WHERE type IS NOT NULL AND elb IS NOT NULL AND target_port IS NOT NULL AND elb_status_code IS NOT NULL AND target_status_code IS NOT NULL AND http_method IS NOT NULL AND http_version IS NOT NULL AND ssl_cipher IS NOT NULL AND ssl_protocol IS NOT NULL AND target_group_arn IS NOT NULL AND chosen_cert_arn IS NOT NULL AND matched_rule_priority IS NOT NULL AND actions_executed IS NOT NULL AND target_status_code_list IS NOT NULL AND classification IS NOT NULL AND classification_reason IS NOT NULL AND lb_node_ip IS NOT NULL AND domain_name IS NOT NULL AND url_host IS NOT NULL AND target_ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY type, elb, target_port, elb_status_code, target_status_code, http_method, http_version, ssl_cipher, ssl_protocol, target_group_arn, chosen_cert_arn, matched_rule_priority, actions_executed, target_status_code_list, classification, classification_reason, lb_node_ip, domain_name, url_host, target_ip ORDER BY n DESC, type, elb, target_port, elb_status_code, target_status_code, http_method, http_version, ssl_cipher, ssl_protocol, target_group_arn, chosen_cert_arn, matched_rule_priority, actions_executed, target_status_code_list, classification, classification_reason, lb_node_ip, domain_name, url_host, target_ip LIMIT 5;

SELECT count() AS pv, received_bytes, sent_bytes FROM elb_logs WHERE http_method = 'POST' AND `@timestamp` >= '2026-09-18 00:00:00' AND `@timestamp` <= '2026-09-27 23:59:59' AND elb_status_code = 200 AND url_path = '/_bulk' AND received_bytes IS NOT NULL AND sent_bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY received_bytes, sent_bytes ORDER BY pv DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 10000;
SELECT count() AS c FROM elb_logs WHERE match(url_path, '[.](env|git|php)([.]|$)');
SELECT count() AS c, extract(url_path, '[.]([A-Za-z0-9]+)$') AS ext FROM elb_logs WHERE url_path IS NOT NULL AND ext != '' GROUP BY ext ORDER BY c DESC, ext LIMIT 10;

SELECT http_method, elb_status_code, `@timestamp`, trace_id FROM (SELECT http_method, elb_status_code, `@timestamp`, trace_id FROM elb_logs WHERE http_method IS NOT NULL AND elb_status_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY `@timestamp` DESC, trace_id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1 BY http_method, elb_status_code) ORDER BY http_method, elb_status_code LIMIT 10000;
